item.description: Good morning, Sydney! It’s Saturday, May 2nd, 2026, and a huge welcome to your Daily Drive. We're looking at a beautiful day shaping up, perfect for getting out and enjoying our gorgeous city, with no major headlines to worry about, just good vibes. Did you know the iconic Sydney Harbour Bridge officially opened on this very day back in 1932? So, let’s get those engines revving and make today another fantastic one!
